title: Card spec: super-editor.document
description: The spec of a `super-editor.document` card. A research document the user can read and edit in place: headings, text, tables, charts and citations. Structure only. A value this schema accepts can still be refused by the validator: rules across fields (duplicates, a tool result that answers no call, ordering, limits that count UTF-16 units) are checked by the validators and pinned by conformance/protocol.v1.json, not here. A value the validators accept always validates.
